mapper.update: update safety_car_out_rule_history set post_name = #{ruleDO.postName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, post_category = #{ruleDO.postCategory,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, organ_code = #{ruleDO.organCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, organ_name = #{ruleDO.organName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remark = #{ruleDO.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, priority = #{ruleDO.priority,jdbcType=INTEGER}, check_flag = #{ruleDO.checkFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, create_time = #{ruleDO.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, update_time = now() where target_id = #{ruleDO.id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: select distinct t.post_name postCode, t.post_name postName from safety_car_out_rule t where t.is_delete = '0' and length(t.post_name) > 0 order by t.post_name

select n.id,n.is_delete isDelete, n.post_name postName, n.post_category postCategory, n.organ_code organCode, h.post_name hpostName,h.post_category hpostCategory,h.organ_code horganCode from safety_car_out_rule n left join safety_car_out_rule_history h on n.id = h.target_id where n.update_time > date_format(concat(date_sub(curdate(),interval 1 day),' 23:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and ((h.post_category is null and n.is_delete='0') or h.post_category is not null)

select n.id,n.is_delete isDelete, n.post_name postName, n.post_category postCategory, n.organ_code organCode, h.post_name hpostName,h.post_category hpostCategory,h.organ_code horganCode from safety_car_out_rule n left join safety_car_out_rule_history h on n.id = h.target_id where n.is_delete='0'

select.foreach:
select r.emp_no from safety_employee_message r where r.status = 'NORMAL'
and r.position_type is null
and r.position_type = #{rule.postCategory}
and r.position_name like concat('%',#{rule.postName},'%')
and (r.position_name = '' or r.position_name is null)
and r.org_code_path like concat('%',#{rule.organCode},'%')
union all select r.emp_no from safety_employee_message r where r.status = 'NORMAL' and r.position_name like concat('%',#{rule.hpostName},'%')
and r.position_type is null
and r.position_type = #{rule.hpostCategory}
union all select r.emp_no from safety_employee_message r where r.status = 'NORMAL' and r.org_code_path like concat('%',#{rule.horganCode},'%')
and r.position_type is null
and r.position_type = #{rule.hpostCategory}

mapper.select: select r.emp_no from safety_employee_message r where r.status = 'normal' and r.update_time > date_format(concat(date_sub(curdate(),interval 1 day),' 23:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')

select cast(min(r.priority) as char) priority,min(r.check_flag) flag, e.position_type postType from safety_car_out_rule r, safety_employee_message e where r.is_delete = '0' and e.emp_no = #{empNo} and r.post_category = e.position_type and r.organ_code = '' and r.post_name = '' group by e.position_type

select cast(min(r.priority) as char) priority,min(r.check_flag) flag, e.position_type postType from safety_car_out_rule r, safety_employee_message e where r.is_delete = '0' and e.emp_no = #{empNo} and r.post_category = e.position_type and r.organ_code <> '' and instr(e.org_code_path,r.organ_code)>0 group by e.position_type

select cast(min(r.priority) as char) priority,min(r.check_flag) flag, e.position_type postType from safety_car_out_rule r, safety_employee_message e where r.is_delete = '0' and e.emp_no = #{empNo} and r.post_category = e.position_type and r.post_name <> '' and instr(e.position_name,r.post_name)>0 group by e.position_type
select count(1) from safety_employee_message e where e.emp_no = #{empNo} and e.position_type = '间接岗位' and e.status = 'NORMAL'
